alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued November 1 at 12:43AM EDT until November 2 at 3:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
alerts.description:
An upper-level low will move atop Florida today through Monday. This
feature will add more moisture and support for showers and storms
than recent days. Strong low-level easterly flow will result in bands
of repeated rainfall for isolated to scattered locations. Showers and
storms are expected to be a bit more widespread with higher rain
rates than the past few days.

* WHAT...Bands of heavy rain may cause urban and street flooding.

* WHERE...All of Palm Beach, Broward, and Miami-Dade counties.

* WHEN...From 10 AM EST this morning through Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Isolated to scattered area of flash flooding will be
possible, with the main impact being street flooding, road
closures, and limited impact to structures in flood prone areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
